passages.text: Zul'jan waits at Atal'Utek, beyond Zul'Aman. Zul'jarra guards Amani'Zar, and de hash'ura stand watch.
Zul-jan waits at Atal-Utek, beyond Zul-Aman. Zul-jarra guards Amani-Zar, and de hash-ura stand watch.
Zuljan waits at Atalutek, beyond Zulaman. Zuljarra guards Amanizar, and de hashura stand watch.
Zool-jan waits at Ah-tahl-Oo-tek, beyond Zool-Ah-Mahn. Zool-jar-rah guards Ah-mah-nee-Zar, and de hash-oo-rah stand watch.
Zooljan waits at Ahtahlootek, beyond Zoolahmahn. Zooljarrah guards Ahmahneezar, and de hashoorah stand watch.
